motions.name: 流行爵士 · 八拍 01
motions.reviewNotes: 0.5.1 anatomy correction: reflected SMPL-X coordinates, neutral-skeleton anatomical axes, separate female/male tracks and bounded/smoothed joint poses. 120 Hz complete-clip signed elbow/knee/finger bends and all 95 Humanoid ranges passed on both characters; actual DancePlayback selected 20 connections passed on both rigs after 0.6-beat blends. Original author label Street / Jazz; New Jazz / pop-jazz personal practice adaptation with simplified hands, not dance-teacher certification. Restricted poses, renders and personal application remain local.
